added.title: Sr. Manager, People Technology and Services
added.description:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Sr. Manager, People Technology and Services

San Mateo, CA

Role Overview

Sony Interactive Entertainment LLC seeks a Sr. Manager, People Technology and Services in San Mateo, CA to partner closely with customers to drive and prioritize the HCM, Compensation, Time and Absence, Security and Integrations technology roadmap and identify level of effort and proactively engage resources required for each project.

Requirements

Master’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science or related field or equivalent and five (5) years of experience in HR Technology architecting scalable HR technology solutions across global organizations; leading cross-functional technical teams and defining and executing multi-year HR technology roadmaps aligned to business strategy; partnering with senior HR and business stakeholders to translate program requirements into Workday solutions; overseeing full lifecycle system implementations, including discovery, requirements, design, UAT, change management, and deployment; managing complex Workday enhancement portfolios, prioritization frameworks, and Agile delivery methodologies; establishing KPIs, measure adoption, drive continuous improvement, and ensure operational excellence; conducting retrospectives, portfolio reviews, and long-term capability planning; directing ownership of SOX audits and designing controls, reporting frameworks, and evidence packages to maintain compliance; providing guidance on new capabilities, AI-driven enhancements, and process optimization in HR Technology; and in executing duties, working with Workday HCM configuration across Core HCM, Compensation, Absence, Security, and Reporting; Workday Integrations, including Workday Studio, EIB, PICOF/PECOS, REST and SOAP APIs; system governance, release management, performance testing, audit processes, and SOX-compliant controls; and Workday security models, role-based access controls, and data privacy requirements.
Telecommuting and/or working from home may be permissible pursuant to company policies.

Please refer to our
Candidate Privacy Notice
for more information about how we process your personal information, and your data protection rights.

At SIE, we consider several factors when setting each role’s base pay range, including the competitive benchmarking data for the market and geographic location.

Please note that the base pay range may vary in line with our hybrid working policy and individual base pay will be determined based on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location.

In addition, this role is eligible for SIE’s top-tier benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, matching 401(k), paid time off, wellness program and coveted employee discounts for Sony products. This role also may be eligible for a bonus package. Click here
to learn more.

$242,050.00 – $284,900.00/year

added.title: Director, Global Security Technology (Remote)
added.description:
The Director, Global Security Technology leads the strategy, architecture, and operating model for a global portfolio of enterprise physical security technology platforms, ensuring scalable, resilient, and integrated capabilities that support business operations, risk management, and digital transformation. This role provides strategic leadership for the Technology Security Center of Excellence (TSCoE) and is accountable for the architecture, governance, lifecycle management, and continuous improvement of enterprise security technology solutions, including access control, video surveillance, intrusion detection, visitor management, alarm systems and related data and analytics capabilities.

This role operates at the intersection of physical security and enterprise information technology, applying modern technology practices – including platform strategy, systems integration, data architecture, and automation – to deliver business-aligned security capabilities.

This leader will partner closely with Enterprise Digital & Technology (EDT), Global Real Estate & Facilities, Procurement, HR, Legal, Privacy, and Regional Security leaders to ensure physical security technologies are aligned to enterprise architecture, embedded in site design and business processes, and positioned to support future growth. The role will leverage emerging technologies, automation, and analytics to strengthen decision-making, operational consistency, and business resilience globally.

Posted Date: 09/09/2026 This role will be posted for a minimum of 3 days.

added.title: Technology Strategy Manager/Sr Manager, Financial Services
added.description:
Technology Strategy Manager / Senior Manager - Financial Services Industry

We Are:

Technology Strategy, and we design and execute industry-relevant reinventions that allow organizations to realize exceptional business value from technology. Our vision is to become the world’s leading advisors
in harnessing technology and innovation as a force to reinvent and improve every business. Our mission is to help client business executives disrupt their industry
and utilize technology to capture market share.

Technology strategy leverages deep business expertise combined with technology know-how, empowering clients to be more competitive by leading initiatives that unlock value and drive growth. We enable leaders to act quickly and confidently as they pivot to the future. Known for our ability to execute at speed, we help our clients disrupt their markets through creating strategies that capabilities in operating model, enterprise architecture, and emerging technologies such as GenAI, rethinking business models for growth, efficiency, and customer satisfaction. We help clients determine clear, actionable paths to competitive agility by bringing them new thinking on business and technology.

You Are:

An expert at advising Financial Services
clients on technology strategies to achieve their vision and operational goals. You have an abundance of energy and drive, resilience, and a passion for collaborating with senior executives. You love continual learning and are intrigued by new challenges. You have a flair for breaking down complex issues into logical parts and constructing analyses driving actionable recommendations. You’ve got top notch communication and leadership skills and a natural talent for appreciating diverse perspectives and bringing out the best in teams.

In Technology Strategy you will:

Serve as trusted advisor to the C-suite defining strategy at the intersection of both technology and business .

Articulate a compelling technology vision with industry and functional expertise .

Shape the role of technology in business strategies to capture market share.

Identify and prioritize value creation opportunities based on detailed assessment and analysis of current technology footprint.

Drive strategic opportunities which incorporate innovative technology solutions into broader business transformations.

Develop operating models and business cases leveraging disruptive technologies.

Lead the creation of well-articulated thought leadership assets that present innovative insight, knowledge, guidance, and recommendations on a specific market-relevant technology strategy.

Pressure-test assumptions made by leadership teams, including AI-generated insights.

Validate AI-assisted analysis with logic, experience, and domain knowledge.

Use AI tools to accelerate research, synthesis, modeling, and scenario analysis.

Use critical judgement to Know when AI outputs are directionally useful vs. when they are unreliable.

As a Manager/Sr. Manager you will:

Lead team, project, and program as well as corresponding deliverables while supervising and mentoring full teams.

Build strong relationships with senior clients that go beyond the workplace, including beginning to develop C-suite relationships; drive a spirit of collaboration and teaming with client while serving as a true trusted advisor

Drive thought leadership, asset development, and intellectual capital efforts with targeted input from more senior resources; identify and advance ideas for new opportunities

Support Business Development, building understanding of how to architect and position proposals and SOWs

Facilitate to drive results and gain consensus for action; able to address difficult client conversations and engage senior client stakeholders to drive meaningful outcomes

Travel as needed

Here’s What You Need:

As a Manager:

Minimum 1 year of strategy consulting experience at a consulting firm

Minimum 5 years of proven experience in at least one of the following: operating model strategy, M&A, tech value and cost take-out, or technology driven revenue growth strategy.

Minimum 5 years of experience writing business cases.

Minimum 2 years of experience leading or managing small teams effectively including planning/structuring analytical work, facilitating team workshops, and developing technology strategy recommendations.

Bachelor’s degree

As a Senior Manager:

Minimum 3 years of strategy consulting experience at a consulting firm

Minimum 6 years of experience in at least two of the following: operating model strategy, technology in M&A, tech value cost take-out, or technology driven revenue growth strategy.

Minimum 6 years of experience writing business cases.

Minimum 5 years of experience leading or managing large teams effectively including planning/structuring analytical work, facilitating team workshops, and developing technology strategy recommendations.

Bachelor’s degree

Bonus Points if:

Comfortable using AI tools for research, synthesis, and analysis.

Ability to evaluate AI outputs critically.

Understanding of data limitations, bias, and model risk

You have an MBA or equivalent graduate degree.

You have shown critical thinking, ability to question decisions and provide creative solutions.

You can manage junior members of the team and can develop them for more responsibility.

You have effective communication and people skills to manage relationships with clients.

You have strong presentation skills: ability to synthesize information and the ability to bring a message forward.

You lead in driving insights and recommendations using data models and visualization tools, demonstrated advanced research skills.

You can develop practical roadmaps that support the enabling of technology transformation.

You can manage a variety of projects with increased complexity.

You have developed project management abilities and have reported and escalated on time to managerial level.
